questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns drivers that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane beneath it will exit the freeway and form a ramp. If you are in this lane, you must either change lanes to continue on the freeway or take the exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs display traffic laws that you must obey. This sign means right turns are prohibited at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers the road is covered with loose gravel. You should drive carefully because your tires will have less traction on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You should drive slower when conditions are not ideal, such as rain, snow, or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers to prepare to stop because a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that from this lane, you may either turn right or continue straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will make a sharp turn to the right, followed by a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign prohibits U-turns wherever it is posted. You cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that the normal road route is blocked and you will need to follow a different path ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road makes a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for exiting a highway. The number shown is the recommended maximum speed for that exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging into your lane, move over to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps traffic flow smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left turns. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass is coming with limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height listed on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a steep downhill section of road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead directing traffic, and you must follow their instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left. They cannot go straight or turn right from this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided and red. You must come to a complete stop, look for pedestrians and traffic from all directions, and only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to red lights, yellow lights, and oncoming cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign is posted at traffic signals to tell you that you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for hazards ahead and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the upcoming bridge may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal indicates it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: This orange work area sign directs you to follow an alternate route around a road that is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to continue in your current direction.
